newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crop condition and progress highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crop condition and progress highlights - USDA.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Agriculture said Monday that 30 percent of the U.S. corn crop had been harvested, compared to 20 percent a week ago and a ive-year average of 46 percent.
In its report on Oct. 20 conditions, USDA said 63 percent of soybeans were harvested. A week earlier, 40 percent had been harvested, and the five-year average is 70 percent.
It also said 95 percent of the soybean crop had reached the dropping leaves stage, up from 89 percent last week. The five-year average is 95 percent.
USDA said 45 percent of the cotton crop was harvested versus 35 percent last week, and 46 percent average.
It said 63 percent of the winter wheat crop had emerged, compared to 44 percent a week ago and 60 percent average.
